verses.original: οὖν Παρακαλῶ ὑμᾶς ἀδελφοί διὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ τῶν οἰκτιρμῶν παραστῆσαι ὑμῶν τὰ σώματα ζῶσαν θυσίαν ἁγίαν τῷ εὐάρεστον Θεῷ τὴν ὑμῶν λογικὴν λατρείαν
verses.transliteration: oun Parakalō hymas adelphoi dia tou Theou tōn oiktirmōn parastēsai hymōn ta sōmata zōsan thysian hagian tō euareston Theō tēn hymōn logikēn latreian
verses.literal: Therefore I urge you brothers on account of - God’s - mercy to offer your - bodies [as] living sacrifices holy - [and] pleasing to God which is your spiritual service of worship

verses.original: καὶ μὴ συσχηματίζεσθε τούτῳ τῷ αἰῶνι ἀλλὰ μεταμορφοῦσθε τῇ ἀνακαινώσει τοῦ νοός εἰς ὑμᾶς τὸ δοκιμάζειν τί τὸ τὸ ἀγαθὸν καὶ εὐάρεστον καὶ τέλειον θέλημα τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai mē syschēmatizesthe toutō tō aiōni alla metamorphousthe tē anakainōsei tou noos eis hymas to dokimazein ti to to agathon kai euareston kai teleion thelēma tou Theou
verses.literal: - vvv Do not be conformed to this - world but be transformed by the renewing of [your] mind Then you - will be able to test and approve what [is] - the good - pleasing and perfect will - of God

verses.original: γὰρ διὰ τῆς χάριτος τῆς δοθείσης μοι Λέγω παντὶ τῷ ὄντι ἐν ὑμῖν μὴ ὑπερφρονεῖν παρ’ ὃ δεῖ φρονεῖν ἀλλὰ φρονεῖν εἰς τὸ σωφρονεῖν ὡς μέτρον πίστεως ὁ Θεὸς ἐμέρισεν ἑκάστῳ
verses.transliteration: gar dia tēs charitos tēs dotheisēs moi Legō panti tō onti en hymin mē hyperphronein par’ ho dei phronein alla phronein eis to sōphronein hōs metron pisteōs ho Theos emerisen hekastō
verses.literal: For by the grace - given me I say to every one - - of you vvv Do not think of yourself more highly . . . than you ought - but think of yourself with - sober judgment according to [the] measure of faith - God has given [you]

verses.original: γὰρ καθάπερ ἔχομεν ἑνὶ σώματι ἐν πολλὰ μέλη δὲ οὐ πάντα τὰ μέλη ἔχει τὴν αὐτὴν πρᾶξιν
verses.transliteration: gar kathaper echomen heni sōmati en polla melē de ou panta ta melē echei tēn autēn praxin
verses.literal: - Just as each of us has one body with many members and not all - members have the same function

verses.original: οὕτως ἐν Χριστῷ ἐσμεν οἱ πολλοὶ ἓν σῶμά τὸ δὲ καθ’ μέλη εἷς ἀλλήλων
verses.transliteration: houtōs en Christō esmen hoi polloi hen sōma to de kath’ melē heis allēlōn
verses.literal: so in Christ we who are - many [are] one body - and each member [belongs to] one another

verses.original: δὲ Ἔχοντες διάφορα χαρίσματα κατὰ τὴν χάριν τὴν δοθεῖσαν ἡμῖν εἴτε προφητείαν κατὰ τὴν ἀναλογίαν τῆς πίστεως
verses.transliteration: de Echontes diaphora charismata kata tēn charin tēn dotheisan hēmin eite prophēteian kata tēn analogian tēs pisteōs
verses.literal: - We have different gifts according to the grace - given us If [one’s gift is] prophecy [let him use] it - in proportion to [his] faith

verses.original: εἴτε διακονίαν ἐν τῇ διακονίᾳ εἴτε ὁ διδάσκων ἐν τῇ διδασκαλίᾳ
verses.transliteration: eite diakonian en tē diakonia eite ho didaskōn en tē didaskalia
verses.literal: [if it is] serving - - let him serve [if it is] - teaching - - let him teach

verses.original: εἴτε ὁ παρακαλῶν ἐν τῇ παρακλήσει ὁ μεταδιδοὺς ἐν ἁπλότητι ὁ προϊστάμενος ἐν σπουδῇ ὁ ἐλεῶν ἐν ἱλαρότητι
verses.transliteration: eite ho parakalōn en tē paraklēsei ho metadidous en haplotēti ho proistamenos en spoudē ho eleōn en hilarotēti
verses.literal: [if it is] - encouraging - - let him encourage [if it is] giving - let him give generously [if it is] leading [ let him lead] with diligence [if it is] showing mercy [ let him do it] cheerfully

verses.original: Ἡ ἀγάπη ἀνυπόκριτος ἀποστυγοῦντες τὸ πονηρόν κολλώμενοι τῷ ἀγαθῷ
verses.transliteration: Hē agapē anypokritos apostygountes to ponēron kollōmenoi tō agathō
verses.literal: - Love must be sincere Detest what [is] evil cling to what [is] good

verses.original: φιλόστοργοι εἰς ἀλλήλους τῇ φιλαδελφίᾳ προηγούμενοι τῇ τιμῇ ἀλλήλους
verses.transliteration: philostorgoi eis allēlous tē philadelphia proēgoumenoi tē timē allēlous
verses.literal: Be devoted to one another - in brotherly love Outdo yourselves - in honoring one another

verses.original: μὴ τῇ σπουδῇ ὀκνηροί ζέοντες τῷ πνεύματι δουλεύοντες τῷ Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: mē tē spoudē oknēroi zeontes tō pneumati douleuontes tō Kyriō
verses.literal: Do not let [your] zeal subside keep your spiritual fervor . . . . . . serving the Lord

verses.original: χαίροντες τῇ ἐλπίδι ὑπομένοντες τῇ θλίψει προσκαρτεροῦντες τῇ προσευχῇ
verses.transliteration: chairontes tē elpidi hypomenontes tē thlipsei proskarterountes tē proseuchē
verses.literal: Be joyful - in hope patient - in affliction persistent - in prayer

verses.original: κοινωνοῦντες τῶν ἁγίων ταῖς χρείαις διώκοντες τὴν φιλοξενίαν
verses.transliteration: koinōnountes tōn hagiōn tais chreiais diōkontes tēn philoxenian
verses.literal: Share with the saints who [are] in need Practice - hospitality

verses.original: Εὐλογεῖτε τοὺς διώκοντας ὑμᾶς εὐλογεῖτε καὶ μὴ καταρᾶσθε
verses.transliteration: Eulogeite tous diōkontas hymas eulogeite kai mē katarasthe
verses.literal: Bless those who persecute you Bless and {do} not curse

verses.original: χαίρειν μετὰ χαιρόντων κλαίειν μετὰ κλαιόντων
verses.transliteration: chairein meta chairontōn klaiein meta klaiontōn
verses.literal: Rejoice with those who rejoice weep with those who weep

verses.original: φρονοῦντες τὸ αὐτὸ εἰς ἀλλήλους μὴ φρονοῦντες τὰ ὑψηλὰ ἀλλὰ συναπαγόμενοι τοῖς ταπεινοῖς μὴ γίνεσθε φρόνιμοι παρ’ ἑαυτοῖς
verses.transliteration: phronountes to auto eis allēlous mē phronountes ta hypsēla alla synapagomenoi tois tapeinois mē ginesthe phronimoi par’ heautois
verses.literal: Live in harmony . . . . . . with one another vvv Do not be proud . . . . . . but associate with the lowly {Do} not be conceited . . . . . .

verses.original: ἀποδιδόντες μηδενὶ κακὸν ἀντὶ κακοῦ προνοούμενοι καλὰ ἐνώπιον πάντων ἀνθρώπων
verses.transliteration: apodidontes mēdeni kakon anti kakou pronooumenoi kala enōpion pantōn anthrōpōn
verses.literal: Do not repay anyone . . . evil for evil Carefully consider what is right in the eyes of everybody . . .

verses.original: εἰ δυνατόν τὸ ἐξ ὑμῶν εἰρηνεύοντες μετὰ πάντων ἀνθρώπων
verses.transliteration: ei dynaton to ex hymōn eirēneuontes meta pantōn anthrōpōn
verses.literal: If [it is] possible - on your [part] live at peace with everyone . . .

verses.original: μὴ ἐκδικοῦντες ἑαυτοὺς ἀγαπητοί ἀλλὰ δότε τόπον τῇ ὀργῇ γάρ γέγραπται ἐκδίκησις Ἐμοὶ ἐγὼ ἀνταποδώσω λέγει Κύριος
verses.transliteration: mē ekdikountes heautous agapētoi alla dote topon tē orgē gar gegraptai ekdikēsis Emoi egō antapodōsō legei Kyrios
verses.literal: {Do} not avenge yourselves beloved but leave room - for [God’s] wrath For it is written Vengeance [is] Mine I will repay says [the] Lord

verses.original: Ἀλλὰ Ἐὰν σου ὁ ἐχθρός πεινᾷ ψώμιζε αὐτόν ἐὰν διψᾷ αὐτόν πότιζε γὰρ ποιῶν τοῦτο σωρεύσεις πυρὸς ἄνθρακας ἐπὶ αὐτοῦ τὴν κεφαλὴν
verses.transliteration: Alla Ean sou ho echthros peina psōmize auton ean dipsa auton potize gar poiōn touto sōreuseis pyros anthrakas epi autou tēn kephalēn
verses.literal: On the contrary If your - enemy is hungry feed him if he is thirsty vvv give him a drink For in so doing . . . you will heap burning coals on his - head

verses.original: Μὴ νικῶ ὑπὸ τοῦ κακοῦ ἀλλὰ νίκα τὸ κακόν ἐν τῷ ἀγαθῷ
verses.transliteration: Mē nikō hypo tou kakou alla nika to kakon en tō agathō
verses.literal: {Do} not be overcome by - evil but overcome - evil with - good
